text: Dow Inc.'s 2026 proxy statement lists the beneficial owners of more than 5% of its common stock as of 31 January 2026: The Vanguard Group (11.4%) and BlackRock, Inc. (6.6%). Vanguard's Schedule 13G/A for Dow Inc. had reported 82,116,884 shares, 11.71% of the class, as of 30 September 2024.
short: Dow Inc.'s largest holders: Vanguard 11.4%, BlackRock 6.6%.

source.name: Dow Inc.: 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A), beneficial ownership of Dow's common stock (SEC EDGAR)
source.note: The quoted row follows the introduction 'beneficial ownership of Dow's common stock by holders of more than 5 percent of the outstanding shares of Dow's common stock'. Percentages are based on shares outstanding as of January 31, 2026.

additionalSources.name: GuruFocus: Vanguard Group Inc's Strategic Acquisition of Dow Inc Shares
additionalSources.note: News article of 5 November 2024 reporting Vanguard's Schedule 13G/A for Dow Inc. It also states the firm was 'now holding 11.71% of Dow's total shares'.
additionalSources.quote: This transaction, which took place on September 30, 2024, increased Vanguard's total holdings in Dow to 82,116,884 shares.
